record.name: Envision Fitness: AI Coach
record.offering: Health & Fitness app; seller description requires review
record.description_evidence:
Fitness finally works together.

Envision Fitness brings training, nutrition, running, recovery, progress, and intelligent coaching into one connected experience. Instead of juggling disconnected apps, you can understand the whole picture and act on what matters today.

TRAIN WITH PURPOSE
• Build, schedule, and complete strength workouts
• Track sets, reps, weight, RPE, rest timers, and personal progress
• Explore a growing exercise library with form guidance
• Review training performance, muscle focus, and gym-specific history
• Use the Apple Watch companion during supported workouts

MAKE NUTRITION SIMPLE
• Log meals, foods, recipes, and serving amounts
• Track calories, protein, carbohydrates, fat, water, and nutrition patterns
• Scan supported barcodes and revisit recent foods
• Plan meals and grocery lists around your goals and budget
• Explore macro-conscious options when eating out

SEE REAL PROGRESS
• Follow weight, body-composition, training, and running trends
• Import supported health and fitness data through Apple Health
• Save progress photos and review meaningful changes over time
• Celebrate achievements, streaks, milestones, and earned XP

RUN WITH BETTER CONTEXT
• Review imported and Envision-recorded runs
• Explore pace, heart rate, distance, splits, routes, and milestones when available
• Replay supported routes and study performance over time

ENVISION INTELLIGENCE
Envision uses the information you choose to provide to surface personalized observations across training, nutrition, activity, recovery, and progress. Guidance is designed to be understandable, practical, and responsive to your goals.

COACHING THAT CONNECTS
Discover trainers, apply to work together, share approved progress information, and keep plans, feedback, and check-ins connected inside the Envision ecosystem.

Envision Fitness provides fitness and wellness information and is not a substitute for professional medical advice, diagnosis, or treatment. Features and available data may vary by device, permissions, region, and connected services.

FormFusion is a revolutionary app that uses AI to give you real-time feedback on your form, like having a personal trainer in your pocket.

•Exercise library and technique guide: Access a comprehensive library of exercises with detailed instructions and video demonstrations to ensure you perform each movement with proper form.

•Fully Customize Your App: Beyond Workouts allows you to personalize the app. Exercise your creative control by fully customizing the app's appearance and changing the color palette. Make FormFusion an extension of your identity!

•Train anywhere, anytime: Ditch the crowded gym and expensive trainers. Work out on your own terms, with your phone as your ultimate coach.

Download FormFusion today and experience the future of fitness. With its cutting-edge AI technology, personalized approach, and comprehensive features, FormFusion is your one-stop shop for achieving your fitness goals, staying injury-free, and loving the journey every step of the way.

Remember, with FormFusion, you're not just working out. You are investing in a healthier, happier you. Take the first stage towards your fitness transformation today!

record.name: myoxin: AI Workout Planner
record.offering: Health & Fitness app; seller description requires review
record.description_evidence:
Build muscle with an AI coach that learns what your body responds best to.

myoxin uses your workouts, recovery, progress, and scientific literature to help you train smarter, get stronger, and stop guessing what to change next.

Log workouts. Ask training questions. Get weekly analysis and statistics. Let your plan adapt. All in the app, and on WhatsApp too if you prefer.

What myoxin does:

• A plan that explains its reasoning
Every session comes with its why: what your coach changed since last time, and what it is responding to. Clear progression you can follow, not a random AI-generated workout.

• Full weekly training analysis
myoxin analyzes your workouts, volume, intensity, muscle stimulus, progression, fatigue, and recovery patterns to show what is working, what is stalling, and what should change next. Every Sunday it reviews the week you actually trained and writes the changes straight into next week's sessions, so the analysis becomes a plan instead of a report. The more you train, the more specific the feedback becomes.

• AI fitness coach in the app or on WhatsApp
Text it. Send voice notes, photos, and videos. Ask what to do in a crowded gym, send a lift video for form feedback, share a restaurant menu for nutrition advice, or send a photo of a terrible hotel gym and get a replacement workout.

• 35M+ scientific papers on demand
Ask questions about hypertrophy, strength training, recovery, nutrition, soreness, deloads, exercise selection, or programming, with answers grounded in scientific literature and your own training data.

• Biology-based muscle stimulus model
myoxin tracks how much useful training stimulus each muscle is getting, so you can see which muscles are undertrained, which are progressing, and where you may be adding volume without much return.

• Wearable and recovery data integration
Connect health and wearable data like sleep, HRV, activity, nutrition, recovery, and body metrics, so your training plan can respond to more than just sets and reps.

• Free by design
No myoxin subscription. Connect your own Google Gemini API key and your coach runs on it. Disconnect any time.


Features:

• Fast workout logging built for between sets
• Strength training, bodybuilding, hypertrophy, cardio, and gym workout tracking
• Set, rep, weight, RIR, warmup, drop set, and failure set logging
• Reusable workout templates
• Weekly workout split planning
• AI workout planner and adaptive training recommendations
• Exercise progress charts
• Estimated 1RM, tonnage, sets, reps, and trend tracking
• Muscle stimulus analytics and muscle heatmap
• Custom exercises and favorite exercises
• Exercise library for strength, cardio, and mobility
• Health and wearable data sync
• Track diet, protein, supplements, stress, illness, and alcohol alongside training
• AI personal trainer support through text, voice, photos, and videos
• Science-backed fitness, nutrition, recovery, and training answers

Most workout trackers only record what you did.

Most AI fitness apps give generic answers.

myoxin is built to close the loop: train, analyze, learn, adapt, repeat.

Less random workout generator. Less generic chatbot with gym vocabulary. More like a personal exercise scientist that actually knows your training.

Download myoxin and start training with a plan that adapts.

Privacy Policy: https://myoxin.ai/privacy

record.description_evidence:
Harley AI — A Fitness Trainer's Best Friend

Built by Doctors. Trained by a Fitness Pro.

A personal trainer with over 100 active clients told two doctors exactly what he needed. They built it.

Harley works for you. Your clients, your business, your way. We make money when trainers subscribe. That's it. We don't sell data and we don't run ads.

WHAT HARLEY DOES

AI Workout Builder
Tell Harley what you need and it builds the workout. Exercises, sets, reps, tempo, rest periods, coaching cues. The exercise library has 2,600+ entries drawn from real sports science research, and when Harley writes a program, the reasoning traces back to actual sources.

Smart Scheduling and Booking
Day, week, and month views. Clients book straight from your storefront. Session credits, group classes, and waitlists are all managed in one place. You stop being a receptionist.

Payments Built In
Your money goes directly to your Stripe account. Accept payments for sessions, class packs, and products. Invoicing, payment history, and revenue tracking live in one dashboard.

Client Management
Workouts, progress, body stats, PRs, nutrition, health data. Assign programs, send messages, and manage your full roster from your phone. One screen per client, everything visible.

Nutrition Tracking
Clients search foods, log meals, and track macros. You set the targets and you see everything they eat. The food database is USDA FoodData Central, the same source dietitians use.

Recovery-Aware Training
Connect Whoop (Apple Watch and Garmin coming soon). Harley reads recovery scores and adapts workout intensity based on how recovered your client is. You push when they're ready and pull back when they're not.

One-Click Migration from Trainerize
Bring your clients, workouts, exercises, programs, and custom videos over in minutes.

Artha: Your Business Brain
Artha tracks your income, monitors your churn rate, and helps you price your services. Every trainer deserves to actually know their numbers.

WHO IT'S FOR

Personal trainers who run their own business. Harley was built alongside Edwin Servellon of Servellon Fitness, a working trainer who manages hundreds of clients on an iPad every day. His workflows, his pain points, and his feature requests shaped every screen. Whether you have 5 clients or 500, Harley grows with you.

PRICING

Starter: Free, up to 5 clients, all AI features with 100 queries per month, no credit card required.
Essentials: $14.99/mo, up to 20 clients, unlimited AI.
Pro: $49.99/mo, up to 75 clients, scheduling, payments, Whoop, Artha, migration.
Business: $99.99/mo, unlimited clients, analytics, priority support, API access.
All plans monthly. Cancel anytime. No contracts.

WHAT MAKES HARLEY DIFFERENT

Most fitness apps stick a chatbot on a calendar and call it AI. Harley is built differently. The exercise library, coaching cues, and safety guidelines come from curated science sources. When Harley recommends a program, you can trace exactly why it chose what it chose.

Two physician co-founders. A hardworking New York trainer who shaped the product from day one. Patent-pending AI that remembers what matters and filters out noise. Your data stays yours.

Artha provides business analytics and income insights, not financial, tax, or investment advice. SYNAP is your intelligent AI fitness coach — built to train you like a real coach would, not a generic template.

Meet Ion, your personal AI trainer. Tell Ion your goals, your equipment, your schedule, and  if you have one upload your InBody scan. Ion reads your real body composition data and builds a training split and nutrition plan around YOUR numbers, not guesses.

• Personalized workout plans — built around your goal, experience, equipment, and schedule, with the right split (push/pull/legs, upper/lower, full body, or a custom program) for you specifically
• Personalized nutrition plans — calorie and macro targets calculated from your real body composition, with meals that fit your preferences and region
• InBody scan analysis — upload a photo of your InBody report and Ion extracts body fat %, muscle mass, BMR, visceral fat, and more to sharpen every future plan
• Smart renewals — every few weeks, Ion checks your progress and adjusts your plan instead of just repeating it
• One-tap exercise swap — can't do an exercise today? Ion instantly swaps in an equivalent movement
• PR celebrations — Ion notices when you hit a new personal record and celebrates it with you
• Weekly streaks — stay consistent and watch your streak grow
• Progress photos — track your transformation visually, stored privately and securely
• Sparks — earn points for every workout logged, meal tracked, streak kept, and PR hit. Redeem Sparks for free Elite access — no purchase required to earn them
• Apple Health integration — sync your workouts and stats automatically
• Chat with Ion anytime — ask questions, request changes, get real coaching, in English or Arabic

SUBSCRIPTION PLANS

• Starter — free, with core workout and nutrition tracking
• Pro — SAR 39.99/month or SAR 319.99/year — full personalized plans, smart renewals, and more

record.name: Fitenium: AI Workout & Gym Log
record.offering: Health & Fitness app; seller description requires review
record.description_evidence:
FITENIUM app is the application and online community for GenAI-powered training and injury prevention.

At FITENIUM app, you will be able to craft your truly personalised workout using Generative Artificial Intelligence or find a training program reviewed by a Human Certified Coach. You will be able to plan and track your own workout program. 

FITENIUM is a Truemed qualified company. This means that your payments could be eligible for HSA/FSA reimbursement. Qualify here: https://app.truemed.com/fitness/qualify/tm_qual_vabfzbjmat.


*Your first workout with FITENIUM*

Choose how you want to train - We know that each person likes to train in a different way, that's why at FITENIUM we provide you with an option for each case.

Create your workout - Choose create your workout if you want to plan your training program by defining your sessions, exercises and reps for each workout.

Find your workout - Choose Find your personalised training program if what you are looking for is a custom workout according to your level, available equipment, goals and frequency, etc.

Track your workout - Choose Track your workout if you want to define exercises, reps and weights that you are going to train in your session. If you train with a coach, we recommend it.




*Your injury alerts*

Access your health profile - Tap on the heart icon that appears on your personal profile screen to access your private health profile.

Meet your digital twin - At FITENIUM you have a visual digital twin that represents your localised state of fatigue in real time as you train and recover.

Avoid injuries while training - Thanks to your digital twin, we are able to analyse your data and send you personalised alerts about where and when you are at risk of injury, based on your workouts.




*Track your progress*

Review your personal bests - In FITENIUM you have a section in your profile with all your personal bests according to the exercises you have tracked during your training.

Visualize your evolution - For each exercise you will have an evolution graph in which you will find your progress in the time range of your selection.

Analyze your exercise history - In FITENIUM you can access the history of repetitions and weights for each exercise. You can use this information to program and adjust your sets while you are training.





*Track your weight*

Follow your body weight - Measure your weight daily at your health profile. In FITENIUM you will be able to visualize a chart with your progress and easily enter new weights.



*Your heart rate while you train*

Your heart rate working out -  Connect FITENIUM to any wearable synced with Apple Health or Google FIT  to track your heart rate during your workouts. This will enable you to follow your exercise intensity and plan your workouts better.

Your heart rate evolution - You might check the evolution of your average heart rate across your workout sessions at your progress charts in your health profile.




*Never miss a workout*

Your workout awaits you - Want to change a song on Spotify? Want to drop a message to someone? Receive a call at the gym? NO PROBLEMO since FITENIUM will always keep your training session open as long as you don't finish or cancel it.



*Create a training habit with FITENIUM*

Transform your training into a digital experience - Share your sessions with the rest of the community, adding photos and videos to the exercises and reps of your workout.

Visualise your workout- Swipe left on each post to find the muscle fatigue visualisation of each shared workout.

Track your weekly streaks - At each user's profile picture, you will see the number of weeks in a row they have been tracking their training with the FITENIUM app.


*Connect with friends*

Invite your friends - If you know other friends who you think would like to train with you using  FITENIUM, you can easily invite them from the invite screen.

CalSnap – Snap & Track Nutrition with AI

Want a smarter way to understand what’s on your plate? CalSnap turns a single photo into a detailed nutrition breakdown—calories, macros, and key nutrients—in seconds. No endless typing, no confusing charts. Just snap, track, and move on with your day.

Why You’ll Love CalSnap

– Photo-First Logging – Point, snap, and your calorie counter, macro tracker, and food diary update instantly.
– Personal Targets – Set daily calories and macros that fit your routine and preferences.
– All-in-One Dashboard – See meals, macros, nutrients, trends, and insights in one clean view.
– Barcode & Search – Scan packages or find foods fast with our smart database.
– Speed & Quality – AI recognizes thousands of foods and estimates portions for accurate tracking.

How It Works

1. Create your profile – Choose your focus (energy, macros, balanced nutrition).
2. Snap or scan – Take a meal photo or scan a barcode; adjust portions if needed.
3. Track & improve – Watch your daily and weekly stats update in real time, with clear insights and trends.

Build better eating habits with less effort. Download CalSnap and make nutrition simple.

CalSnap is free to download. Photo Logging, Personal Targets, and the All-in-One Dashboard are available with a paid subscription.

CalSnap provides general wellness information only and does not offer medical advice.

Welcome to AtlasFit, the AI fitness coach designed to help you train smarter, track better, and see real results. Whether you are just starting your fitness journey or looking to stay consistent, AtlasFit combines AI coaching, calorie tracking, workout planning, and progress analysis in one powerful app.

AtlasFit adapts to you. It learns from your habits, goals, and data to deliver personalized workouts, nutrition guidance, and insights that evolve as you progress. No guesswork, no generic plans.

Key Features

AI Fitness Coach
SuperChat is your personal AI coach that helps you log meals, track workouts, analyze progress, and stay motivated. It provides smart suggestions, answers fitness questions, and adjusts recommendations in real time based on your data.

Calorie & Nutrition Tracking
Easily scan meals, barcodes, and foods to track calories, protein, carbs, and fats. AtlasFit simplifies nutrition tracking so you can stay consistent without stress.

Workout Planner & Training Programs
Get personalized workout plans tailored to your goals, whether it is weight loss, muscle gain, or overall fitness. Train at the gym or at home with structured routines that adapt as you improve.

Progress & Analytics Dashboard
Monitor your weight, calorie intake, hydration, workouts, personal records, and trends in one intuitive dashboard. Visual charts and AI insights help you understand what works and optimize your routine.

FitSquad Social Challenges
Stay motivated by joining challenges with friends and other users. Compete on leaderboards, share progress, and build accountability through friendly competition.

All-in-One Fitness Tools
Track water intake, log gym sessions, save personal records, explore exercises, and access nutrition ideas. AtlasFit brings everything together so you can focus on results.

Why AtlasFit

Personalized guidance powered by AI
Simple and accurate calorie tracking
Smart workout planning for beginners and general fitness users
Clear progress tracking and insights
Social motivation through challenges
One app for workouts, nutrition, and coaching

AtlasFit is built for people who want structure, clarity, and real progress without complexity.

Download AtlasFit today and take control of your fitness with an AI coach that works with you, every step of the way.
